name: Paperclip agent host (SSH + Claude Code + Together Link)
description: Prepares a dev container as a Paperclip SSH target on the shared paperclip-net network: key-only sshd on 2222, Claude Code and Together Link on the SSH PATH, shared fleet config from the host's ~/.paperclip, and a manifest whose slug is the network alias.

projectName.description: Optional human-friendly project name. Empty derives it from the workspace (git remote, package metadata, folder name, then hostname).
